post.caption: Lucite carries light around corners. A clear Lucite rod carries a beam of light around bends. Lucite is DuPont's brand name for clear acrylic plastic. DuPont began selling it in the 1930s. Makers carved designs on the back so they show through the front. Confetti Lucite holds glitter or tiny flakes inside the clear plastic. Moonglow Lucite looks lit from within, like a moonstone. In the 1950s, Lucite handbags looked ultra modern and very stylish. Many had glitter or confetti sealed between layers of clear Lucite. Collectors say Lucite has no smell, but older acetate smells like vinegar.
